name: ENGIE S.A. INH.  EO 1
summary: Engie SA is a global energy and services group focused on three core activities: production of low-carbon electricity, namely from natural gas and renewable sources; global networks, namely gas, power and heat networks; and customer solutions. Engie operates in numerous countries and is headquartered in Courbevoie, France. Engie offers a wide range of energy-related services to businesses, local authorities and individuals.
